description: The complete Revopush AI Outreach Playbook (developer infrastructure). Without arguments: its goal, audience estimate and every audience; with playbook: the selected published edition; with audience_number: that audience's research, why the sequence works, the current opener, two follow-ups and targeting. Use it to show what a playbook contains before anyone buys.

audience_number.description: The audience to read in full, as numbered in that playbook's overview.

playbook.description: Which published playbook to open; revopush (default).
